page_title: JUV 1-0 GEN | Juventus v Genoa 29/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's the end of the match.
90+3' Timothy Weah (Juventus) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper, but his effort is straight at Nicola Leali, who is alert and makes an easy save to deny him.
90+3' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
90+1' A cross into the box from Lorenzo Venturino (Genoa) is cleared. The ball is behind the touchline and Genoa will take a throw-in.
90+1' Juventus take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
89' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
88' The foul by Timothy Weah (Juventus) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Antonio Rapuano.
88' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
86' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) is adjudged offside.

85' A dangerous towering header by Koni De Winter (Genoa) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the right post. This corner kick didn't change the score. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
84' Now Genoa have a corner.
84' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Lorenzo Venturino (Genoa). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
82' Igor Tudor has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Timothy Weah (Juventus) replacing Nicolas Gonzalez.
80' It is time for a substitution. Morten Thorsby (Genoa) is on for Fabio Miretti.
80' Antonio Rapuano has a clear sight and sees a foul from Koni De Winter (Genoa).
77' Antonio Rapuano interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Fabio Miretti (Genoa).

74' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the left side of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
73' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

72' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. Juventus force their opponents to concede a corner.
72' Today's referee Antonio Rapuano rightly decides to book Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) for his harsh tackle.
71' Substitution. Andrea Pinamonti makes his way off the pitch and Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) comes on as his replacement.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) comes onto the pitch for Jean Onana.
70' Juventus are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
66' Igor Tudor prepares a substitution. Teun Koopmeiners is replaced by Francisco Conceicao (Juventus).
63' Substitution. Alessandro Zanoli did his best and is replaced by Lorenzo Venturino (Genoa).
63' Genoa can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

63' Genoa are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. Genoa have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

61' Genoa slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
59' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Antonio Rapuano blows for a foul.
59' The number of shots on goal at present is 3:2.
56' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) has received a yellow card for his foul.
53' Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
52' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
50' The ball possession is 48:52.
48' Referee Antonio Rapuano halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Igor Tudor, then shows him a yellow.
48' The game is interrupted. Morten Frendrup (Genoa) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Genoa are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
41' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.

40' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Antonio Rapuano with no other option than to blow for a foul.
37' The resulting set piece from Genoa is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
37' Genoa are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. Genoa earn a corner.
36' Wonderful movement by Genoa. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
33' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) is penalised for a foul. Antonio Rapuano had a clear view and blows his whistle.
31' Antonio Rapuano shows the yellow card to Khephren Thuram (Juventus) for a heavy challenge.

31' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Juventus are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
28' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
27' Igor Tudor is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Federico Gatti suffers an injury and Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) comes on.

25' 1 - 0 Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Nicola Leali is just a bystander as the ball flies into the left side of the goal. The score is 1:0.
24' Jean Onana (Genoa) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
21' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
19' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.

19' Juventus show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Juventus.
16' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) gets on the end of a pass and takes a low shot from the edge of the box which is straight at Michele Di Gregorio, who makes a comfortable save.
16' Federico Gatti (Juventus) is able to continue to play.
15' Federico Gatti (Juventus) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.
13' Federico Gatti (Juventus) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
13' The ball is cleared after Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
10' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Michele Di Gregorio.
7' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) is caught offside!
4' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Juventus.
4' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Juventus.
3' Juventus seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Genoa will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Antonio Rapuano.
